operational_meaning: Any severe or serious adverse event triggers response-policy review before signal interpretation.
Candidate-input changes are documented one primary variable at a time where feasible.
No candidate signal is interpreted without baseline window and variability estimate.
Infection, medication change, hospitalization, fall, sleep collapse, travel, or caregiver disruption must be annotated before interpretation.
Default primary interpretation requires >=70% Tier 1 daily and weekly completion unless protocol justifies alternate threshold.
>=0.3 SD directional change can flag review only; not validated responder criterion.
APPRE records only as-administered observational exposure under separate lawful clinician-governed ethics-approved oversight if present.
Participant/caregiver burden triggers simplification before data ambition.
Every material update includes date, reason, window, reviewer, prior policy link.
EEG sessions require sleep, caffeine, acute illness, medication, and artifact context before primary interpretation.
New cycles establish fresh baseline estimates; prior cycles are hypotheses, not established effects.
Matched EEG-biomarker analysis requires documented synchronization window.
Public release increments version log and manifest; raw identifiable data excluded.
